insights.title: Skills & Match Insights
insights.subheading: Understand the explainable logic and weighting behind your job match scores.
insights.skillsDesc: Evaluates exact & semantic matches for mandatory and preferred technical skills.
insights.experienceDesc: Compares relevant years of experience against role requirements.
insights.seniorityDesc: Measures alignment with track level (Junior, Mid, Senior, Lead).
insights.educationDesc: Checks degree level and field-of-study relevance.
insights.languageDesc: Evaluates Indonesian, English, or other language proficiencies.
insights.locationDesc: Scores domestic vs global scope and remote/hybrid compatibility.
insights.bestDesc: Exceptional alignment with all must-have criteria and strong skill overlap.
insights.strongDesc: Strong overall profile fit with minor preferred skill or track variations.
insights.potentialDesc: Viable role but may contain non-critical gaps or require skill bridging.
insights.lowDesc: Significant gaps in mandatory requirements or domain alignment.
insights.actionHint: Adjust your target roles, locations, or region scope to discover fresh matches.

hero.title: Find work—one that matches your experience.
hero.description: Turn one digital CV into an editable profile, a focused search, and match results you can inspect before you apply.

preview.label: Candidate Fit Evidence
preview.description: Inspect granular scoring dimensions, verified strengths, and actionable gap recommendations before applying.
preview.recommendationBody: Highlight your dbt data transformation projects to maximize recruiter alignment.

score.title: A match is more than one number.
score.description: The score separates fit signals so you can decide what to verify, improve, or skip.

workflow.title: From document to next move.
workflow.description: The product follows the way a careful job search actually works: start with evidence, keep the profile editable, then choose where to focus.

intake.label: Intake
intake.title: Start with the CV you already have.
intake.body: Upload a digital PDF or DOCX. The system extracts structure without asking you to repeat your work in a chat box.

review.label: Review
review.title: Keep the profile in your hands.
review.body: Review and edit the extracted candidate profile before discovery begins. Your confirmed version becomes the source of truth.

match.label: Match
match.title: See what deserves your time.
match.body: Compare relevant roles across Indonesia or global searches, then save, apply, ignore, or open the original listing.

trust.title: Useful AI stays inspectable.
trust.description: The system accelerates discovery without inventing a version of your career or taking the application out of your hands.
trust.controlBody: AI extraction is a starting point. You can edit the structured profile before the first search.
trust.privacyBody: Original files live in private storage, with a user choice to retain or delete the original after parsing.
trust.boundaryBody: Hirevia helps you decide and track. You still open the canonical listing and choose what happens next.

cta.title: Start with the document you trust.
